scope: Input-only actual OmniControl fidelity mechanism diagnostic, separate from controlled656
hypothesis: Moving the lumbar pivot and shoulder midpoint once to robust D-derived effective centres reduces a fixed torso prior mismatch. The constructed frames are geometric assumptions, not observed rotations or anatomical calibration.
frame_selection: Previously fixed from original model: three uniform frames plus three highest D shoulder-relative residuals
evaluation: Conditional torso local solve and relaxed radial lower bounds; no R and no temporal pass claim. Preserve baseline. A successful diagnostic requires a new full-window fit, export and regression before adoption.
runtime_constraints: One numerical worker, single thread; no change to queued unifiedv2 or heldout use
